userStories.title: Create video CRUD API routes
userStories.description:
Build API routes for video management:
- GET /api/videos - List all videos with optional tag filter
- POST /api/videos - Create new video
- GET /api/videos/[id] - Get single video
- PUT /api/videos/[id] - Update video
- DELETE /api/videos/[id] - Delete video

userStories.title: Build video library page with tag filtering
userStories.description:
Create /videos page showing all saved videos in a grid/list. Include:
- Tag filter sidebar/bar
- Search by title
- Video thumbnail preview
- Quick actions (play, edit, delete)

userStories.title: Create add video form
userStories.description:
Build /videos/new page or modal for adding videos:
- YouTube URL input with validation
- Auto-fetch video title from YouTube (or manual entry)
- Tag selector (multi-select, create new tags)
- Optional notes field

userStories.title: Integrate YouTube IFrame API for video playback
userStories.description:
Set up YouTube IFrame API integration:
- Embed player on video detail page
- Control playback (play, pause, seek)
- Get current playback time for syncing with cues
- Handle player events

userStories.title: Build video player page with workout UI
userStories.description:
Create /videos/[id] page - the main workout screen:
- Large YouTube player
- Timer display panel
- Exercise cue overlay area
- Controls for timer and video
- Log workout button
